whitelist-vat.title: VAT white list
whitelist-vat.description: Verify business buyers: Polish NIP on the white list and in GUS, EU VAT numbers in VIES.

disabled.title: The plugin is disabled
disabled.hint: Fix the plugin options in medusa-config.ts and restart Medusa.

statusHint.active: Registered as an active VAT payer on the white list.
statusHint.exempt: On the white list as exempt from VAT.
statusHint.unregistered: The business exists but is not a registered VAT payer.
statusHint.inactive: GUS reports that this business has ended its activity.
statusHint.valid: VIES confirms this EU VAT number.
statusHint.invalid: The number has a wrong format or check digit, or VIES does not confirm it.
statusHint.not_found: The registers answered and none of them knows this number.
statusHint.unverified: No register could be asked. This says nothing about the number; try again later.

problem.unknown_country: The country prefix is not an EU member state.
problem.format: This is not a valid number for that country.
problem.checksum: The check digit is wrong: there is probably a typo in the NIP.

whitelist-vat.staleHint: This answer is older than the cache time. Check again for a current one.
whitelist-vat.fromCacheHint: No new request: a recent answer was reused for this record.

subjects.title: Businesses
subjects.subtitle: The latest answer for every tax ID verified in this store.
subjects.empty: No businesses yet. They appear here when a buyer's tax ID is verified.
subjects.name: Business

history.title: Verification history
history.subtitle: Every answer of every register, newest first.

lookup.title: Look up a business
lookup.subtitle: Check a Polish NIP or an EU VAT number. Numbers without a prefix are read as Polish.
lookup.force: Ask the registers even if a recent answer is stored
lookup.name: Name
lookup.bankAccounts: Bank accounts on the white list

bank.title: Check a bank account
bank.subtitle: Ask the white list whether an account belongs to a NIP today, for example before paying a supplier.
bank.assigned: Yes: this account is registered for the NIP.
bank.notAssigned: No: this account is not registered for the NIP.
bank.invalid_nip: This is not a valid NIP.
bank.invalid_account: This is not a valid Polish account number.
bank.unavailable: The white list could not be asked: {{error}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: The options in use, read-only. They are set in medusa-config.ts.
settings.mfHint: No key needed. The ministry allows about 100 requests a day.
settings.gusHint: Knows every business, not only VAT payers. No daily limit.
settings.gusOff: Set gus.apiKey to use it. Keys are issued free of charge at api.stat.gov.pl.
settings.viesHint: Confirms EU VAT numbers. No key needed.
settings.viesNoRequester: Set vies.requesterVatNumber to your own EU VAT number to get a consultation number as proof.
settings.verifyOnOrder: Verify when an order is placed
settings.gusDemo: Demo mode: answers come from sample businesses, without a key and without asking GUS.

record.title: Tax ID verification
record.noTaxId: No tax ID on this record.
record.noTaxIdHint: The plugin looks for it in metadata under: {{keys}}.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.body: GUS answers with sample businesses (names start with [DEMO]); no key is needed and no request goes to GUS. The white list and VIES are asked as usual. Remove demo: true from the options to use the real GUS.
